# TSI

> TSI provides precision measurement solutions, instrumentation, and software for air quality monitoring and industrial hygiene across healthcare, manufacturing, environmental, and occupational safety markets.

TSI Incorporated, headquartered in Shoreview, Minnesota, specializes in aerosol science and precision measurement technologies. The company serves diverse industries including semiconductor manufacturing, healthcare facilities, HVAC systems, emergency response, and environmental monitoring through products like OmniTrak and comprehensive testing solutions.

## Key Topics

- Precision Measurement
- Air Quality Monitoring
- Aerosol Science
- HVAC Testing & Balancing
- Occupational Health & Safety
- Indoor Air Quality (IAQ)
- Cleanroom Monitoring
- Respirator Fit Testing
- Dust Monitoring
- Industrial Hygiene
- Environmental Monitoring
- OmniTrak Solution
- TSI Link
- Workplace Safety
- Noise Monitoring
